agent_kind: Codex manual rebuild in shared workspace
formal_run_note: Old Example 6 artifacts were backed up. The formal harness run was rebuilt from the Bouc-Wen beam-column prompt, with MATLAB, OpenSeesPy, and ABAQUS all completing and passing cross-validation.
abaqus_note: ABAQUS uses a compiled Bouc-Wen UEL through run_abaqus.ps1, which initializes Intel oneAPI Fortran and Visual Studio Build Tools before running Abaqus 2025.
key_correction: The ABAQUS frame uses B23 elastic beam elements to match the Euler-Bernoulli beam-column stiffness used by the MATLAB assembly and OpenSeesPy elasticBeamColumn model; the earlier B21 trial was too flexible.
